frozen: 2026-11-01, by the map's owner's decision ('I don't care about [no group may get worse], I want the overall accuracy to keep getting better'), after desert refits #2 and #3 had been scored on development data and before any candidate was run on sealed set d.
benchmark: scripts/benchmark_local.py --regions dev31 at 56 km: the 19 regions of policy.json plus the 12 predeclared in regions_dev12.json; equal-region means
development_regions: the 31 dev31 regions plus the retired sealed sets a, b and c (calibration/sealed_20261031, sealed_20261031b, sealed_20261101c): 49 regions, all development data.
score: S = 0.5 * T_monthly_mae / T_ref + 0.5 * P_loss / P_ref, equal-region means, the reference being the current adopted physics run on the same code and sources. S49 is this over all 49 development regions; S31 over dev31 alone (reported).
adopt_if: S49 improves by at least 0.5 % (overall accuracy over every development region)
neither T_monthly_mae nor P_loss over the 49 worsens by more than 1 %
paired 28 km check on california, western_europe, japan, new_zealand: S not worse by more than 1 %
the next unseen sealed set (now calibration/sealed_20261101d), run once: S not worse (<= 1.0)
group_note: group scores (training, holdout, mid-latitude, dev12, each retired set) are reported but no longer block adoption.
sealed_regions: one unseen set per adopted milestone, run once; once run it joins the development regions.
